name: Kelp
author: Erin Carter
description: A stand of kelp in section: dark ribbon blades rooted to an uneven seafloor band, rising near-black through still water. When a surge front rolls across the stand the downstream edges light, a thin rim of glow climbing each blade and glinting in the float bulbs, colour ascending from deep roots to pale tips before the forest hangs calm again.

params.label: Surge rate
params.effect: How often surge fronts roll through the kelp stand.

params.label: Sway
params.effect: How far the blades lean downstream and overshoot on the elastic return.

params.label: Blade width
params.effect: CSS-pixel width of the kelp ribbons, from straps to broad fronds.

params.label: Rim glow
params.effect: Brightness of the edge light that climbs the blades while they bend.
